instructions: Place the salmon fillet skinned-side up.
Smear the fillet with dijon honey mustard.
Arrange the thinly sliced zucchini over the fillet with the peel on, overlapping the slices like scales.
Combine the dill, garlic, olive oil, black pepper, and salt in a bowl.
Smear the herb mixture over the zucchini scales.
notes: Text submission. The source's 'Skinned side of the salmon' was a fragment — interpreted as placing the fillet skinned-side up for the scales.
